format_notice: PointCast local catalog format, not a universal standard or shopping integration.
name: First Offer Kit
description: Editable worksheets, examples, offer page, original SVG cards, and handoff checklists for one useful digital product or bounded service.

delivery.public_url_note: The publishing page supplies the deployment URL; none is assumed inside this portable archive.

limitations: Files only: no checkout, inquiry submission, payment processing, authenticated receipt or delivery system.
Worked examples are fictional; sample prices are planning guesses, not approved offers or evidence of demand.
The described activity pack is not included; its editable offer card is included.
No legal, tax, or financial advice; no earnings, customer, support, protocol compliance, or platform listing promise.
No scripts, telemetry, external assets, accounts, or automatic updates in these files.
